Anna: Heads-up: PR #8249 (image-transform) is blocked by CI — snapshot test `test_image_transform_snapshot` is failing intermittently. Any quick ideas? /cc @Mike H @Sara (QA)
ci-bot: Build failed on linux-x86-64: `test_image_transform_snapshot` — 1 snapshot mismatch. Logs: https://ci.internal/1823456789/build/45
ci-bot: ```
AssertionError: images differ (pixel diff > 0.02)
Expected: image_0128.png
Actual:   image_0128.actual.png
Diff metric: 0.034
```
Mike H: I saw similar flicker on canaries yesterday. Likely non-deterministic ordering in augmentation pipeline. Is it reproducible locally?
Anna: Can't repro locally with seed=42. Fails only in CI queue: `test_image_transform_snapshot` ~3/10 runs.
Sara (QA): If it's flaky, we should either rerun or update snapshot after confirming. Can you trigger a rerun? I'll watch results.
Anna: Triggering a rerun now.
ci-bot: Re-run queued by Anna — rebuild #46
ci-bot: Re-run finished — same test failed on 2/3 shards. Stack: image_diff_comparator.py:74
Leo: Possibly race in reading random seed from env. Add deterministic seed or pin numpy RNG before transform?
Mike H: Agree. If we can't fix quickly, we can add `@flaky` to the test and create a follow-up ticket, but prefer to stabilize before merge.
Anna: I pushed a quick change that sets `np.random.seed(0)` in the test setup (commit: anna/fix-seed).
ci-bot: Build started for commit anna/fix-seed (build #47)
ci-bot: Build passed on all shards. Tests: 120 passed. Build #47. Link: https://ci.internal/1823456880/build/47 :tada:
Sara (QA): :thumbsup: Can you add a short comment explaining why the seed is needed to avoid regressions?
Anna: Added a comment in the test explaining the CI nondeterminism and the seed. Ready for merge — needs 1 approval.
Mike H: :eyes: I'll give a quick review now.
Mike H: LGTM. Approving.
Anna: Merging after CI green. Thanks everyone :rocket:
ci-bot: Merge completed: PR #8249 merged to main by Anna. Deploy will follow.
